## New
- White app icon background with a red play button
- Search is back in the main app, showing only videos from your approved channels
- 129 approved channels: waz, ghazal, tilawat, Islamic cartoons, halal comedy and halal drama
- No news channels yet — that choice is still open

## Improved
- Recommendations are now off everywhere: no up-next videos, no end-screen suggestions, no discovery shelves
- Home shows only your approved channels' uploads, newest first
- The app starts faster: all approved channels are built in, with no extra lookups
- The player now blocks any video from a channel that is not approved
